title: The composer uses the Mac's own controls and layout
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeGmail, open a conversation in the Work inbox and press r; then press c for a new message
Add two synthetic recipients, press ⇧⌘C and ⇧⌘B, hover a chip and its x, then click From and pick the Team address
Attach two files, hover the tools at the right of the bottom bar, then switch between the Light, Dark and Paper themes
Press Cmd+J, then Escape; pop the message out into its own window
expected: Labels end at one edge with hairlines between rows. Chips are rounded rectangles in a light accent tint, each with its x, which brightens on hover. From is a borderless pop-up; the Team address's reason is grey text on its row. Send is a filled accent button showing ⌘↵; the tools sit in grey capsules like the toolbar, Discard on its own; Draft saved is grey.
